output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-991b39bb2be7] is one item in the list introduced by the section header [ev-1f419676f177]. That header says Loki metrics that start with `cortex_` change to start with `loki_` in this release. It adds that operators can keep the `cortex_` prefix by changing `metrics_namespace` from its default `loki` to `cortex`. Together these give the subject (the metric `cortex_prometheus_notifications_latency_seconds_sum`), the change (renamed to the `loki_` prefix), who is exposed (deployments whose `metrics_namespace` is the default `loki`, not `cortex`) and the consequence (the metric is exported only under the new `loki_`-prefixed name). The proposals treated the bullet on its own and missed this header.
